comment: Every Palsa client is generated from openapi/palsa.yaml by scripts/generate-sdks.sh.
The generator version is pinned in openapitools.json so a regeneration is reproducible: an unpinned
generator would rewrite nine libraries differently on a different day, and the diff would be noise.
Change the API in the spec, run the script, commit what it produces.
